patch_description: The current neighborhood screen always spends its first nine LP evaluations on the same energy-first ordering. When those moves are topologically similar, that can waste evaluations exploring nearly identical changes. Measure pairwise topology distance among the 40 best surrogate-ranked moves and adapt the initial batch: use more far-apart representatives when the pool is clustered, and retain more energy-ranked moves when it is already diverse. Keep the existing dual-guided and random reservations afterward, so this changes only the energy/diversity portion of screening.
